en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a waterfront view of a port city, with a number of ships docked in the harbor and rows of buildings and houses in the foreground and background. The scene is labeled 'Sundsvalls Hamn.' The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp, and printed text with instructions, indicating it was sent from Sweden.
